create_visdom_hook: create a VisdomHook instance with server host, port, and environment name to plot training metrics
plot_learning_curvisdom: plot learning curves to visdom by calling on_phase_end on a VisdomHook with a task object
register_visdom_hook: register the visdom hook using the register_hook decorator to enable metric visualization during training
track_phase_metrics: track phase loss, learning rate, and meter values by invoking on_phase_end on a VisdomHook instance
configure_visdom_environment: configure a VisdomHook with a custom environment name and title suffix for organized metric plotting
